description: Disconnect one Google account: revoke its grant at Google (POST oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke) and delete only that account's tokens from the vault. Other accounts are untouched. If it was the default, the next connected account becomes the default. A revoke failure is reported in revoke_status and the local credentials are still deleted. For an account migrated from the pre-multi-account credential, the legacy vault entries are deleted too.
embedding_description: Unlink one Google account (work, home or a personal Gmail) from this assistant: revoke its access at Google and delete only its stored tokens, leaving other linked accounts working. Reports whether the revoke succeeded and which account is the new default.

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm which account was disconnected and name the new default if one changed; mention revoke_status only when it is not revoked.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.unknown_account: no connected account matches; the message lists the connected accounts. gsuite.invalid_params: account missing.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Pick an email or alias from the listed accounts (list_accounts).
